liebermann.notes: f. 41, in a different hand and quire from the rest of the volume, the Instituta Cnuti; the quire containing I Cn 13–II Cn 15 is lost.

entries.text_de: Oxford Bodley Digby 13; f. 41, in and. Hd. und Lage als der Rest des Bandes, um 1175 Inst Cn, u. S. 612; doch ist die Lage, die I Cn 13—II Cn 15 enthielt, verloren.
entries.text_en: Oxford, Bodley Digby 13; f. 41, in a different hand and gathering from the rest of the volume, c. 1175, Inst Cn, below, p. 612; but the gathering that contained I Cn 13—II Cn 15 is lost.

transcription.doubts: 'I Cn 13—II Cn 15' is roman, not bold (checked); '1175' roman.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): mid-12th century. The one manuscript of the short text (ending at III 44) that is not part of Henry of Huntingdon; it shares a common source (O’Brien’s β; posited by Liebermann as dhu) with the Huntingdon interpolation.

notes.text: f. 41, in a different hand and quire from the rest of the volume, the Instituta Cnuti; the quire containing I Cn 13–II Cn 15 is lost.
